defaults_tls.description: Enable TLS/SSL for all accounts by default.

defaults_tls_certcheck.description: Enable server certificate verification by default.

defaults_auth.description: Default authentication method selection strategy (e.g., 'on' for auto, 'plain', 'scram-sha-256').

defaults_timeout.description: Default network timeout in seconds. Only rendered if not 180.

defaults_delivery_args.description: Arguments for the default delivery method. e.g. ['/var/mail/user'] for mbox, ['/usr/bin/procmail', '-f', "'%F'", '-d', '$USER'] for mda.

defaults_keep.description: Keep mails on the server by default.

defaults_only_new.description: Process only new messages by default.

defaults_uidls_file.description: Default file to store UIDLs in.

accounts.description: List of account configurations to generate account blocks for. The first account is implicitly used as default if multiple exist unless 'account default' is explicitly added in logic (here we add 'account default' if >1 account). Each item is a map with the following fields.
